
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/liuxuming/p/22679807" title="发布于 2026-08-25 16:24">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">uniapp连接斑马打印机ZD421 蓝牙打印：从踩坑到出纸</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div>用 uni-app 给斑马（Zebra）ZD421 打一张 100mm × 150mm 的面单，</div>
<br>
<div>环境：uni-app Vue2、App 真机（安卓小米13）、斑马 ZD421</div>
<div>本项目因为之前已经走通汉印打印机的蓝牙通信，时长会默认走CPCL。</div>
<div>但是斑马必须走ZPL,终于走通了</div>
<div>
<ul class="ui-markdown__list ui-78zum5 ui-dt5ytf ui-1ae8yn7 ui-13vk20g ui-1e8yfua ui-j7cesy ui-1bae07f">
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">每次切 <code class="ui-markdown__inline-code ui-rtu7ee ui-1i9v5mb ui-1hhlpkd ui-6lrnw6 ui-115g5cq ui-odjx36 ui-1wd3ewq ui-hayvgc ui-eb7xqv ui-15bjb6t ui-1lldw8n ui-1mzt3pk md-inline-variable-like">onceLength</code> 字节</li>
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">每包间隔 <span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">300ms</span></li>
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">失败最多重试 <span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">15 次（整包重发）</span></li>
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">用 <code class="ui-markdown__inline-code ui-rtu7ee ui-1i9v5mb ui-1hhlpkd ui-6lrnw6 ui-115g5cq ui-odjx36 ui-1wd3ewq ui-hayvgc ui-eb7xqv ui-15bjb6t ui-1lldw8n ui-1mzt3pk md-inline-path-filename-like"><span class="ui-markdown__inline-path-filename ui-1heor9g md-inline-path-filename">uni.writeBLECharacteristicValue</span></code></li>
</ul>
<ul class="ui-markdown__list ui-78zum5 ui-dt5ytf ui-1ae8yn7 ui-13vk20g ui-1e8yfua ui-j7cesy ui-1bae07f">
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">内容必须转成二进制</li>
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">中文必须 GBK</li>
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">指令也要转二进制</li>
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">BLE 一次接收有限，建议 20 字节递归分包，</li>
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item=""></li>
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">
<div>
<div>## 面单 ZPL 样例</div>
<br>
<div>下面是斑马文档里那张经典面单，加上纸张尺寸后可以直接发：</div>

<br>
<div>```zpl</div>
<div>^XA</div>
<div>^PW800</div>
<div>^LL1200</div>
<div>^CF0,60</div>
<div>^FO50,50^GB100,100,100^FS</div>
<div>^FO75,75^FR^GB100,100,100^FS</div>
<div>^FO93,93^GB40,40,40^FS</div>
<div>^FO220,50^FDIntershipping, Inc.^FS</div>
<div>^CF0,30</div>
<div>^FO220,115^FD1000 Shipping Lane^FS</div>
<div>^FO220,155^FDShelbyville TN 38102^FS</div>
<div>^FO220,195^FDUnited States (USA)^FS</div>
<div>^FO50,250^GB700,3,3^FS</div>
<div>^CFA,30</div>
<div>^FO50,300^FDJohn Doe^FS</div>
<div>^FO50,340^FD100 Main Street^FS</div>
<div>^FO50,380^FDSpringfield TN 39021^FS</div>
<div>^FO50,420^FDUnited States (USA)^FS</div>
<div>^CFA,15</div>
<div>^FO600,300^GB150,150,3^FS</div>
<div>^FO638,340^FDPermit^FS</div>
<div>^FO638,390^FD123456^FS</div>
<div>^FO50,500^GB700,3,3^FS</div>
<div>^BY5,2,270</div>
<div>^FO100,550^BC^FD12345678^FS</div>
<div>^FO50,900^GB700,250,3^FS</div>
<div>^FO400,900^GB3,250,3^FS</div>
<div>^CF0,40</div>
<div>^FO100,960^FDCtr. X34B-1^FS</div>
<div>^FO100,1010^FDREF1 F00B47^FS</div>
<div>^FO100,1060^FDREF2 BL4H8^FS</div>
<div>^CF0,190</div>
<div>^FO470,955^FDCA^FS</div>
<div>^XZ</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>业务里只要把 `^FD` 后面的文字、条码换成订单数据。坐标原点在标签左上，单位是点。</div>

</div>
</li>
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">多少无益，需要源代码的找我，平时不在线，打赏做个敲门砖</li>
<li class="ui-markdown__list-item ui--default-marker ui-exx8yu ui-1xpa7k ui-18d9i69 ui-1uhho1l ui-13faqbe ui-ez2fb" data-md-list-item="">

</li>
